name: Dish
summary: This dish, produced in Jingdezhen in southern China and decorated in Canton, belongs to a group of Chinese export wares characterised by erotic or 'gallant' subjects. The particular scene on this example shows a reclining naked woman being viewed by a voyeur or 'peeping Tom' dressed as Harlequin. Er
